summary: Jeff Higgins, 52, of Colorado Springs, died of heat-related illness after running out of water near mile marker 28 of the Palisade Plunge trail during record 102 degF heat; three other riders found him around 6:45 p.m. Saturday, had also run out of water and were treated for dehydration.
location: Palisade Plunge trail, mile 28, near Grand Junction
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search and Rescue, Palisade Fire Department, CareFlight
notes: Victim name (Jeff Higgins) from later memorial-shelter coverage; memorial shade shelter built at his spot opened for the 2025 riding season.
